title.en: A formation's couplings as its blanket, and when a blanket constrains
title.zh: 形成之耦合为其毯，及毯何时有所约束

statement.en: Any model fed by what couples into a formation is by construction the agent of a blanketed law whose sensory course is the formation's own course; a degenerate reading refutes no family whose law is determined, while a sparse partition fixed apart from the family can be refuted by one run.
statement.zh: 以耦合入一形成者为食之任一模型，依构造为一毯化之律之主体，其感官历程即该形成之自身历程；退化之读不驳任何其律确定之族，而独立于族而定之稀疏之分可为一运行所驳。

laws.en: The coupling law: where a formation's couplings give the values of what couples into it, any model and policy, and any environment, which may read the act, make a blanketed law whose sensory part's next state is the value of what couples in at the step, the step on the world's side; its sensory course is the formation's own course through its couplings under its own level history (sensory_course and four more).
laws.zh: 耦合之律：一形成之耦合予耦合入者之值，则任一模型、策略与环境（可读其作为）成一毯化之律，感官部分之次态为当步耦合入者之值，步在世界一侧；其感官历程即该形成于自身层级历史下经其耦合之自身历程（sensory_course 等五项）。

laws.en: Two of its courses from one agent are alike on the blanket before n + 2 exactly where their own level histories are alike through the couplings up to n, the environment reading the act or not; then their internal courses agree up to n + 2. In the closed loop both sides are read off one course (blanket_iff_through, internal_through_couplings).
laws.zh: 同一主体之二历程于 n + 2 前于毯上相同，恰当其自身层级历史至 n 经耦合相同，环境读其作为与否皆然；此时其内部历程至 n + 2 相合。闭环中两侧读自同一历程（blanket_iff_through、internal_through_couplings）。

laws.en: In the open loop, the act moving no level, every reading of the internal course up to n + 2 is a selection through the formation's couplings up to n, whatever the model and the policy (internal_selectsThrough and five more).
laws.zh: 开环中（作为不移层级），无论模型与策略，内部历程至 n + 2 之每一读皆为经该形成之耦合至 n 之选择（internal_selectsThrough 等六项）。

laws.en: The threshold witness's join is its case: at the witness's web, with the supply as the environment state beside the step, the two courses correspond part by part and the witness's blanket_iff_through follows (ThresholdCase.threshold_case and ten more).
laws.zh: 阈之例之相接为其一例：于例之网，供给为步旁之环境态，二历程逐部分相应，例之 blanket_iff_through 由之而得（ThresholdCase.threshold_case 等十一项）。

laws.en: A part of the next configuration depends only on a reading where configurations agreeing under one map go, under one move, to ones agreeing under another; DependsOnlyOn and GoAlike are cases by definition, and Determined is equivalent to the case where both are the identity; the law a family shows has such a part exactly where the family is consistent under the two maps (shownBy_partDependsOnlyOn_iff and five more).
laws.zh: 次构型之一部分唯依一读：于一映射下相合之构型，经同一移，至于另一映射下相合者；DependsOnlyOn 与 GoAlike 依定义为其例，Determined 等价于二映射皆为恒等之例；族所示之律有此部分，恰当族于二映射下一致（shownBy_partDependsOnlyOn_iff 等六项）。

laws.en: A law determined part by part, the agent's parts by what the agent reads and the world's by what the world reads, moves kept, partial or not, is the blanket's form on the law a family shows: a family is admitted by one exactly where it is consistent part by part, and such a law is determined (admitted_iff and six more).
laws.zh: 逐部分确定之律（主体诸部分依主体所读，世界诸部分依世界所读，保留诸移，偏或全）为族所示之律上之毯之形：一族为此律所容，恰当其逐部分一致；此律确定（admitted_iff 等七项）。

laws.en: A blanketed law, read as a process with the trivial move, is determined part by part, and its courses form a family consistent part by part; the converse needs a next state at every reading no course shows, and is not stated (blanketed_courses_consistent and two more).
laws.zh: 毯化之律作为平凡之移之过程逐部分确定，其诸历程成逐部分一致之族；逆向需于无历程所示之每一读择一次态，未陈（blanketed_courses_consistent 等三项）。

laws.en: Parts and pairs agreeing piece by piece are one; what each side reads and its parts (parts_eq and six more).
laws.zh: 诸部分与对逐件相合则为一；每侧所读及其诸部分（parts_eq 等七项）。

laws.en: Readings of the course: with which course and the step in the external part, every family of courses is a blanketed law's course family, consistent or not; a reading of the course's future, no clock, does it for every course; with the step alone two courses alike at steps 0 and 1 parting at 2 have no law determined part by part (clock_only_fails and twelve more).
laws.zh: 历程之读：外部持哪一历程与步，则每一历程之族皆为一毯化之律之历程族，一致与否；读历程之未来（无时钟）亦于每一历程然；唯持步，则于第 0、1 步相同、第 2 步分离之二历程无逐部分确定之律（clock_only_fails 等十三项）。

laws.en: Readings of the configuration: the constant reading gives every family the blanket's form, the whole configuration as the internal part exactly the families whose law is determined; any injective reading gives it only where the law is determined, and not always there (whole_iff and five more).
laws.zh: 构型之读：常值之读予每一族以毯之形，整个构型为内部部分则恰予其律确定之族；任一单射之读唯于律确定处予之，且其处未必予（whole_iff 等六项）。

laws.en: A sparse partition fixed apart from the family, on a law the same at every step, can be refuted by one run: in a run whose internal part's next state is whether the external part, cycling through three values, is at its first, the run is the course of no blanketed law on its four parts, while the whole configuration reads it in the blanket's form (ReadsExternal.not_blanketed and nine more).
laws.zh: 独立于族而定之稀疏之分，于每步皆同之律，可为一运行所驳：内部部分读外部部分（三值循环）是否处其首之运行，于其自身之分下非其四部分上任一毯化之律之历程，于整个构型下则成毯之形（ReadsExternal.not_blanketed 等十项）。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Any web, formation and couplings by level, supplied, whose values the web's admission and the levels give (ValuesThrough); any model, policy, environment state, levels and environment step.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。任一网、形成与所给之层级耦合，其值由网之准入与层级所予（ValuesThrough）；任一模型、策略、环境态、层级与环境之步。

hypotheses.en: For the readings: any family of courses with moves, and any map from configurations to four parts, read by one map at every step of a law the same at every step.
hypotheses.zh: 诸读：任一带移之历程之族，及自构型至四部分之任一映射，于每步皆同之律之每一步以同一映射读之。

hypotheses.en: Modelling choices: discrete synchronous steps; determined laws; the four parts of types in Type; the blanket as sparse coupling, not conditional independence; which map a thing's partition is read by is not derived.
hypotheses.zh: 建模之选择：离散同步之步；确定之律；四部分之类型在 Type；毯为稀疏耦合，非条件独立；物之分以何映射而读，未推出。

does_not_show.en: That having the coupling law constrains a formation's course: it is a construction, the step on the world's side and the environment arbitrary.
does_not_show.zh: 具耦合之律约束形成之历程：此为构造，步在世界一侧，环境任意。

does_not_show.en: The formation's own record as the internal part: the agent is a model fed by what couples in.
does_not_show.zh: 形成自身之记录为内部部分：主体乃以耦合入者为食之模型。

does_not_show.en: The World's own exchange as an environment: the World's case is the open loop, the closed loop a model beside it.
does_not_show.zh: 世界自身之交换为环境：世界之情形为开环，闭环为其旁之模型。

does_not_show.en: A blanketed law for every family consistent part by part: a next state at every reading no course shows is needed.
does_not_show.zh: 每一逐部分一致之族皆有毯化之律：需于无历程所示之每一读择一次态。

does_not_show.en: That the principle is wrong: no sentence of its literature is forbidden here.
does_not_show.zh: 原理有误：此处不禁其文献之任何语句。

detail.en: The run whose internal part's next state is whether the external part, cycling through three values, is at its first is the course of no blanketed law on its four parts (ReadsExternal.not_blanketed).
detail.zh: 内部部分之次态为外部部分（三值循环）是否处其首之运行，非其四部分上任一毯化之律之历程（ReadsExternal.not_blanketed）。

detail.en: With the step but not which course outside, two courses alike at steps 0 and 1 and parting at 2 have no law determined part by part (clock_only_fails).
detail.zh: 外部持步而不持哪一历程，则于第 0、1 步相同、第 2 步分离之二历程无逐部分确定之律（clock_only_fails）。

detail.en: Under the identity reading, injective, a run whose law is determined is not consistent part by part (injective_converse_fails).
detail.zh: 于恒等之读（单射）下，律确定之运行非逐部分一致（injective_converse_fails）。

detail.en: Two courses from one value parting at their first step: the family is not consistent, its clocked reading consistent part by part (clocked_witness).
detail.zh: 自一值出发、于首步分离之二历程：族不一致，而其带时钟之读逐部分一致（clocked_witness）。

validation_scope.en: Pure core, every axiom report empty (core receipt 20261031T231958.020578Z): BlanketCouplings (43 theorems in 76 declarations) imports Blanket, Histories and IdentificationRuns, a leaf; comparisons by matching and congrArg, no decide. One result in three parts, each near-definitional; the classification is the delta. Reviewed by other AI agents: the design (REVIEW-UE27-DESIGN, fifteen findings), the scratch Lean (REVIEW-UE27-LEAN, fifteen, with its probe) and the landing texts and records (REVIEW-UE27-LANDING, twenty-two), every finding taken; study section 488; not reviewed by a person.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核，公理报告皆空（核心回执 20261031T231958.020578Z）：BlanketCouplings（43 条定理，76 项声明）引 Blanket、Histories 与 IdentificationRuns，为叶。一结果三部分，皆近乎定义；分类为其增量。他 AI 代理审之：设计（REVIEW-UE27-DESIGN，十五条）、草稿 Lean（REVIEW-UE27-LEAN，十五条）、落地文本与记录（REVIEW-UE27-LANDING，二十二条），凡所见皆取；研究第 488 节；未经人审。

next_delta.en: The formation's own record as the internal part of a blanketed law; a blanketed law for a family consistent part by part, with a choice at the readings no course shows; review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 形成自身之记录为毯化之律之内部部分；逐部分一致之族之毯化之律（于无历程所示之读择之）；人之审查。

correspondence.en: The principle defines a thing by its Markov blanket (Friston 2013, 2019; Kirchhoff, Parr, Palacios, Friston and Kiverstein 2018). That a blanket depends on how a partition is read is argued in words: Pearl's blankets, fixed within a model, against Friston's, read as a thing's boundary (Bruineberg, Dołęga, Dewhurst and Baltieri 2022). The wider criticism: a formalism applying to any domain is a narrower account of life and mind than claimed (Raja, Valluri, Baggs, Chemero and Anderson 2021); the statistical and dynamical definitions are not equivalent (Biehl, Pollock and Kanai 2021); the proponents class the existence claim with principles of stationary action, not falsifiable strictly speaking (Ramstead and others 2023). The coupling form is the deterministic case of the time-unrolled blanket (Virgo, Rosas and Biehl 2022); since that blanket compares courses from one start, a single run constrains nothing under it. The single-run witness is of the kind of Hexagram.runsOrder_reads. AI reading: which blanket a thing has is how its parts are read; the join is a construction and forbids nothing of the formation's course. The readings are the AI's, in DESIGN.md.
correspondence.zh: 原理以马尔可夫毯定一物（Friston 2013、2019；Kirchhoff、Parr、Palacios、Friston、Kiverstein 2018）。毯依分之读法，已以言论之：Pearl 之毯定于模型之内，与 Friston 之毯读为物之界相对（Bruineberg、Dołęga、Dewhurst、Baltieri 2022）。更广之批评：适用于任何领域之形式，作为生命与心智之说明较所称者为窄（Raja 等 2021）；统计与动力之定义不等价（Biehl、Pollock、Kanai 2021）；倡之者将存在之主张归于驻定作用之原理，严格言之不可证伪（Ramstead 等 2023）。耦合之形即时间展开之毯之确定情形（Virgo、Rosas、Biehl 2022）；该毯比较同一起点之诸历程，故其下单一运行无所约束。单一运行之见证与 Hexagram.runsOrder_reads 同类。AI 之读：物有何毯，在其诸部分如何读；相接乃构造，不禁该形成之历程之任何事。读法皆 AI 之读，载于 DESIGN.md。

aliases: A formation's couplings as its blanket

detail.en: Blanket.Blanketed, its course, agent_through_sensory and internal_through_blanket; ThresholdDrain, whose join is the coupling law's case.
detail.zh: Blanket.Blanketed、其历程、agent_through_sensory 与 internal_through_blanket；ThresholdDrain，其相接为耦合之律之一例。

detail.en: Web.ValuesThrough, courseThrough, AlikeThroughUpTo, SelectsThrough and alikeThrough_iff: the formation's own course through its couplings, which the sensory course is.
detail.zh: Web.ValuesThrough、courseThrough、AlikeThroughUpTo、SelectsThrough 与 alikeThrough_iff：形成经其耦合之自身历程，即感官历程。

detail.en: ShownBy, ConsistentFamily, Admits, shownBy_le_iff and shownBy_determined_iff: the law a family shows, read part by part.
detail.zh: ShownBy、ConsistentFamily、Admits、shownBy_le_iff 与 shownBy_determined_iff：族所示之律，逐部分而读。

detail.en: Hexagram.runsOrder_reads: a line-by-line reading of a law the same at every step refuted, the same kind of witness as ReadsExternal.
detail.zh: Hexagram.runsOrder_reads：逐爻之读于每步皆同之律上被驳，与 ReadsExternal 同类之见证。

detail.en: The blanket's statistical form; this record states the coupling form's existence and when it constrains.
detail.zh: 毯之统计之形；本记录陈耦合之形之存在及其何时有所约束。

detail.en: The existence claim's weighting form, which forbids only with a weighting fixed apart from the course; the coupling form is refuted under a sparse partition fixed apart from the family, a degenerate reading refuting no family whose law is determined.
detail.zh: 存在之主张之权之形，唯以独立于历程而定之权禁之；耦合之形于独立于族而定之稀疏之分下被驳，退化之读不驳任何其律确定之族。

history.en: 1 November 2026: added (UE27), which blanket a thing has: any model fed by what couples into a formation is by construction the agent of a blanketed law whose sensory course is the formation's own course, the threshold witness's join its case; the three levels at which a blanket's existence constrains; after reviews of the design, the Lean and the landing texts, every finding taken; study section 488.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日：新增（UE27），物有何毯：以耦合入一形成者为食之任一模型依构造为一毯化之律之主体，其感官历程即该形成之自身历程，阈之例之相接为其一例；毯之存在有所约束之三层；经设计、Lean 与落地文本之审查，凡所见皆取；研究第 488 节。
